adjustsTheNumberOfWorkersBased: Adjusts the number of workers based on the waiting time of requests in the queue.
appNameIsPartOfThe: App name is part of the Endpoint URL. You can define an app name as needed. Default to Endpoint ID
automaticallyAdjustsTheNumberOfWorkers: Automatically adjusts the number of workers based on the number of requests in the queue.
idleTimeoutIsTheTimeFor: Idle timeout is the time for idle worker threads to keep running for new requests (in seconds). You will be charged for idle timeout.
maximumNumberOfWorkersToScale: Maximum number of workers to scale up to, helps controlling costs
minimumNumberOfWorkersToKeep: Minimum number of workers to keep, helps reducing cold start time
setTheMaximumTimeATask: Set the maximum time a task can wait in the queue before being discarded.
